basis.governing_question: Why did prepaid churn rise in 2025 at Lusitania Telecom, and how can it be brought down?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why prepaid churn rose in 2025 across customer behavior, retention offers and store operations.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Accept the causes found for the 2025 prepaid churn rise as the basis for design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the retention program for prepaid customers, with its offers, store actions and rollout plan.

gate.label: Program approval
gate.decision: Approve the retention program and its rollout plan?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the approved retention program with Lusitania Telecom's teams and measure early churn movement against the diagnostic baseline.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Accept the rollout results and the next steps for the retention program?

workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: Which prepaid customer groups churned more in 2025, and what changed in their behavior before leaving?
activities: Extract operational data on prepaid customer activity
Analyze 2025 churn by customer group and tenure
Interview customers who left in 2025

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: How did prepaid customers respond to the retention offers, and where did the offers not hold them?
activities: Review documents on retention offers made to customers
Compare churn of customers with and without an offer
Interview commercial staff who design and run the offers

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: How do store processes and staff handling of prepaid customers contribute to churn?
activities: Observe how stores serve prepaid customers
Interview store staff and managers on churn and retention
Analyze operational data from stores on prepaid customers

workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: Which prepaid customers should the program target, and which churn measures will show whether it works?
activities: Define target customer groups from the diagnostic findings
Set churn measures and tracking rules against the baseline

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: Which offers make up the retention program for prepaid customers, and what rules govern each?
activities: Draft offer options from the diagnostic findings
Test the options with commercial staff and customers
Specify rules and tracking for each offer in the program

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: Which store actions and rollout steps carry the retention program to prepaid customers?
activities: Define store actions for each offer and customer group
Test store actions with store staff and managers
Sequence the rollout across stores and teams

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: How do prepaid customers respond to the approved retention offers once they are live?
activities: Launch the approved offers to the target customer groups
Monitor offer uptake and refine rules with client teams
Gather customer feedback on the offers during rollout

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: Do store teams carry out the approved store actions, and what blocks them where they do not?
activities: Brief and train store teams on the approved store actions
Roll out the store actions following the agreed sequence
Check store adherence through visits and operational data

workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: How far has prepaid churn moved against the diagnostic baseline since the program went live?
activities: Build the churn tracker against the diagnostic baseline
Compare churn by customer group and by store
Report early churn movement at check-in and readout

deliverables.name: Prepaid churn baseline by customer group and tenure
Causes of the 2025 prepaid churn rise for sign-off
Store handling findings for prepaid customers
Target customer groups for the retention program
Retention offer set with rules and tracking
Store actions and rollout plan for program approval
Retention offers live for target customer groups
Store actions in place with trained store teams
Prepaid churn tracker against the diagnostic baseline
Rollout results and next steps for the retention program

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, team and calendar
events.decision: Confirm the engagement scope, team and calendar?
agenda: Present the objectives, phases and deliverables of the engagement
Align on client and project team roles
Confirm the steering calendar and next steps

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.decision: Accept the causes found for the 2025 prepaid churn rise as the basis for design?
agenda: Present the prepaid churn baseline by customer group and tenure
Review the retention offer and store handling findings
Discuss the causes of the 2025 prepaid churn rise

events.label: Program approval
events.purpose: Review the program design and rollout plan
events.decision: Approve the retention program and its rollout plan?
agenda: Present target customer groups, churn measures and tracking rules
Review the retention offer set and the store actions
Discuss the rollout plan ahead of program approval

events.label: Check-in: early rollout
events.decision: Confirm the early results and the next steps to put to the final readout?
agenda: Present live offers, store actions and the churn tracker
Review early churn movement against the diagnostic baseline
Discuss the next steps to put to the final readout

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Review rollout results and next steps
events.decision: Accept the rollout results and the next steps for the retention program?
agenda: Present the rollout results against the diagnostic baseline
Review live offers, store actions and the churn tracker
Decide whether to accept the results and next steps

architect_notes: The 4, 3 and 6 week split of the stated 13 weeks is an estimate; rollout falls below the archetype's eight-week minimum.
Design was added to the performance improvement archetype because the brief asks how to bring churn down, not only why it rose.
Measurement after launch is not planned; churn results beyond the 13 weeks are not covered, so confirm whether tracking is expected.
